Location search We are where you are! As the world market leader in the field of temperature probes for heat meters and a leading manufacturer of sensor and automation technology, JUMO helps find solutions to the global challenges of our time. We develop components and systems for a wide range of industries including heating and air conditioning, food and beverage, renewable energy, and water and wastewater treatment. More than 2500 employees worldwide work for our support of these industries.
